notes.title: IMPROVED JUMP MECHANIC and PHYSICS
notes.content:
[b]IMPROVED JUMP  and PHYSICS for LEVELS 1-7[/b] 

Always trying to give to the player a better experience and after some comments I've improved jump mechanic and physics.

notes.title: Share your adventure
notes.content:
From the home screen just click over the old parchment (green circle) to see your roadmap where the results of each level you have passed are found:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38840648/6fe67a762428973fd7ac02cb66345a11cd4324c5.png[/img]

In your roadmap just click over the photographic camera icon and a screenshoot will be taken:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38840648/5fd07853295ecbf7b5ce44ac088e9eefdd14f2b7.png[/img]

You'll find those pictures (*.PNG format) in the "redcap" folder of your game insallation directory.

notes.title: Making things easier
notes.content:
Trying to make a game that any streamer will be able to pass the first level without crying:

Modified main character collider. Now it's smaller so it's more easy to jump and to avoid enemies ... I hope ,,,

notes.title: Red Cap Zombie Hunter FREE DEMO is playable !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38840648/a742ac06b58d5cfbcd13d000f669b3b93c3a7f1b.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399250/Red_Cap_Zombie_Hunter/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399250/Red_Cap_Zombie_Hunter/[/url]

The demo let you play the first level of the game (Full game will have up to 33 levels).

It is [b]2d platform arcade[/b] game made in Unity. The story that inspires the game is typical: virus attacks mankind turning most of them into zombies only a few, the strongest one, manage to overcome the virus and remain as normal people. From a central office in the city, a Human Resistence leader, hires [b]Red Cap[/b] as [b]ZOMBIE HUNTER[/b].

[b]I hope you will enjoy the game and add it to your wishlists. [/b]

Your feedback is greatly welcomed and appreciated.

[url=http://vialgames.com/]Vialgames.com[/url]
